title: Comparing membranes and bone substitutes in a one -stage procedure for horizontal bone augmentation. Three-year post-loading results of a double-blind randomized controlled trial
authors: Merli M, Moscatelli M, Mariotti G, Pagliaro U, Raffaelli E, Nieri M. Eur J Oral Implantol. 2018;11(4):441-452.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “No significant differences were observed in this randomised controlled trial comparing anorganic bovine bone with porcine collagen membranes versus synthetic resorbable bone made of pure β-tricalcium phosphate with pericardium collagen membranes for horizontal augmentation” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
